name: SN 2016aps field (Hubble)
blurb: SN 2016aps field, the dwarf host galaxy of an extremely energetic supernova, seen by Hubble.
label: ps16aqy-hubble
story: SN 2016aps was one of the most energetic supernovae ever recorded, possibly the death of a very massive star in dense surrounding gas. Hubble's images found its previously unseen host, which appears to be a dwarf galaxy, with the blast in its brightest star-forming region.

claims.text: SN 2016aps radiated more energy than any other confirmed supernova (as of the paper)
It may come from a very massive star interacting with dense circumstellar material
Hubble imaging identified the previously undetected host galaxy, which appears to be a dwarf galaxy
The supernova occurred in the brightest star-forming region of its host
